prefab.name: Minecraft Java Edition
prefab.description: Minecraft Java server: vanilla, Paper, Fabric, Forge or NeoForge.

motd.label: Message of the day
motd.help: Shown in the server list (59 characters max).

loader.label: Loader
loader.help: Chosen at deployment: switching loaders requires a new server.

version.label: Minecraft version
version.help: LATEST, SNAPSHOT or a version number (e.g. 1.21.4).

level_seed.label: World seed
level_seed.help: Empty: random seed. Used when the world is created.

view_distance.label: View distance
view_distance.help: In chunks. Higher values use more resources.

online_mode.label: Mojang account check
online_mode.help: Disable only behind a proxy (Velocity, BungeeCord).

rcon_password.label: RCON password
rcon_password.help: Generated at deployment, used by the Kuro console.

server-properties.description: Server configuration. Keys driven by settings are rewritten on start.

whitelist.description: Players allowed when the whitelist is on.
